notes_for_editor: Only the 2017 NHLR entry and two quoted newspaper items cover this tower. The 1920s build date is 'believed' per NHLR, so no built event is recorded. The 212 ft figure is the site elevation, not tower height; no tower height found. Access restricted is inferred from the removed lower landings, not an official rule. Four searches, including the Wikipedia Louisiana list, found no LDAF tower record for Caldwell Parish. The 1957 entry is a rainfall report, so treat it as a weak mention. The page prints the newspaper as 'The Monroe New-Stars'; the story uses Monroe News-Star.
